title: Extraction and Cipher
author: Dominic Amberdale
blurb: Hazel Reyes, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
